summary: On node1 (AlmaLinux 9), created unprivileged user appsvc, installed rootless podman, enabled linger for appsvc (login-session-independent), ran an nginx:alpine container as appsvc bound to host port 8080 via rootless port mapping, and generated/enabled a systemd --user unit (container-webapp.service) so the container starts at boot without any active login session. Verified end-to-end with a full node reboot: boot_id changed, no login sessions existed post-restart, and the service and container came back up automatically serving HTTP 200 on port 8080.
actions_performed: Installed podman and dependencies via dnf on node1
Created unprivileged user appsvc (useradd -m) with subuid/subgid ranges for rootless containers
Enabled systemd linger for appsvc (loginctl enable-linger) so user services run without an active login session
Ran nginx:alpine container as appsvc, rootless, with -p 8080:80, verified HTTP 200
Generated a systemd --user unit via 'podman generate systemd --new --name --files --restart-policy=always' for the webapp container
Enabled and started container-webapp.service under appsvc's systemd --user instance (systemctl --user enable --now)
Verified no active login session for appsvc while container/service ran
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service/container health baseline
Issued 'sudo systemctl reboot' on node1, waited for reconnect
Verified changed boot_id post-restart, confirmed no login sessions, confirmed container-webapp.service active and container serving HTTP 200 on port 8080

evidence.requirement: Containerized web app runs as unprivileged user appsvc on port 8080
evidence.summary: appsvc created as unprivileged uid 1000; nginx:alpine container started by appsvc via rootless podman with -p 8080:80; curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200

evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
evidence.summary: Linger enabled for appsvc giving a persistent systemd --user instance independent of login sessions; systemd --user unit container-webapp.service generated, enabled, and confirmed active while loginctl showed 'No sessions'; unit set enabled prior to restart
Pre-restart boot_id 67f3a44b-85c6-40fe-8529-fcb6e8ac337a captured; container-webapp.service confirmed enabled; podman ps showed webapp container running

evidence.requirement: Node restart executed safely, one at a time, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: 'sudo systemctl reboot' backgrounded so acknowledgement returned before node1 disconnected; subsequent probe timed out confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id 9a3aedf3-8591-4cb3-ad68-4d963c5c7f49 differs from pre-restart 67f3a44b-85c6-40fe-8529-fcb6e8ac337a, and uptime -s shows a new boot timestamp, proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service, data, and no-login-session condition
evidence.summary: After restart: loginctl shows no sessions for appsvc (linger state), systemctl --user is-active reports 'active' for container-webapp.service, podman ps shows a freshly started webapp container, and curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200
